description: Source code for handling PKCS12 (P12) certificate store operations including loading, destroying, and retrieving certificates and keys, using OpenSSL library functions.

classes.name: P12Store
classes.description: Structure representing a PKCS12 store with associated key, certificate, and CA chain.

methods.name: p12StoreDestroy
methods.description: Frees all resources associated with a P12Store instance.

methods.name: p12StoreLoad
methods.description: Loads a PKCS12 store from a file given a path and passphrase.

methods.name: p12StoreGetCert
methods.description: Returns a copy of the certificate stored in the P12Store.

methods.name: p12StoreGetPEMKey
methods.description: Returns the private key in PEM format from the P12Store.

methods.name: p12StoreGetPEMCACerts
methods.description: Returns CA certificates in PEM format, optionally including the root.
